name: Web site
description: Look after a static web site folder: preview it in the browser (only this computer can open it), find what is wrong in it (markup, missing title or alt text, duplicate ids, broken links, images, styles and #anchors, file names whose case would break on Linux, unbalanced CSS), list its pages, pack it as a zip. Nothing is fetched from the internet and nothing in the site is changed. Give the site's folder (or one .html file of it) as the input.

presets.label: Preview in the browser
presets.description: Serves the folder on 127.0.0.1 (a free port from 8200); PHP files run. It stops by itself; extra argument: how many minutes (1-240, default 30). Hidden files (.git, .env) are never served and a URL that matches no file answers 404, like on a real server.

presets.label: Stop the preview
presets.description: Stops the preview server of this folder.

presets.label: Check the site
presets.description: Every page and style sheet: markup errors, missing <title>, lang, charset, viewport and alt text, duplicate ids, old tags, empty links, and every relative link, image, script, style and #anchor that points nowhere (a file name that differs only in case is reported as broken: it works on Windows and fails on Linux).

presets.label: Broken links only
presets.description: Only the relative links, images, scripts, styles and #anchors that point nowhere. External links are counted, never visited.

presets.label: List the pages
presets.description: A table of every page with its title.

presets.label: Pack as a zip
presets.description: A zip of the site without hidden files, .git, node_modules and editor backups, ready to upload.
